caption: The drawing depicts a single abstract object positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The object has an irregular, quadrilateral base that appears solid, rendered in muted earth tones, including shades of brown, blue, and hints of reddish hues. From the top central area of the base, an undulating, looped extension rises and curves, creating an open space within itself. The object displays visible shading and gradients, suggesting volume and subtle surface dimples or textures. There is a small, faint patch of brownish-orange marks slightly to the right of the object, and in the lower right corner of the image, the name "WM HOFFMAN" is written in small, uppercase letters.
title: Hoe Blade
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
